answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using bonded vouchers at each network inlet. To transact, an agent must secure attestations routed through a mesh where peers whisper trust ratings. An adversary cannot forge valid vouchers without depositing scarce financial collateral into slashable escrow per persona, enforcing a linear capital cost. However, this mechanism disadvantages undercapitalized honest agents and fails to halt wealthy cartels.
